name: Akhenaten
description:
Akhenaten is an open-source reimplementation of the classic city-building simulation game Pharaoh and its expansion Cleopatra: Queen of the Nile. It reconstructs the game engine in modern C++ to run natively on modern operating systems while utilizing the original game assets.

Features:
- Native cross-platform engine with high-resolution and widescreen support
- Accurate recreation of economic, agricultural, and monument construction mechanics
- Support for original Pharaoh and Cleopatra campaign missions and custom scenarios
- Modernized user interface scaling and audio playback enhancements
- Active open-source development improving pathfinding and simulation stability
